description: Full detail for a single market: chain, curve address, supply, fee rates, current price in the chain's native asset, and which read path serves its trade history. Free.

chainId.description: Chain id of the market, for a ticker that trades on more than one chain (list_markets shows chainId). Without it the oldest market for that ticker is used.

symbol.description: Market ticker, for example PARCEL or ADEXTO. Required and has no default: the gateway refuses a missing ticker rather than quoting one, so a typo can never bill you for a token you did not ask for. Call list_markets first if you do not know it.

name: get_market

agentId.description: ERC-8004 agent id on the market's chain.

source.description: token-contract when read from the token now, registry-copy when copied at launch.

agentIdentity.description: The ERC-8004 agent the token is bound to, or null when unbound.

buyResource.description: x402 URL that sells this market.

creator.description: Creator address, paid the creator fee.

detail.description: Why it refused, or extra context on a successful answer.

error.description: Present only when the tool refused, as a stable code such as unknown_market. Nothing was spent.

historySource.description: indexer, market-index or rpc-logs: which read path serves trade_history.

known.description: On unknown_market: the tickers that do exist.

lpFeeBps.description: Fee kept in the curve, in basis points.

priceNative.description: Price of one token in the native asset.

contract.description: Stake contract: the market's own, or its chain's stake hub.

howToStake.description: The two calls a hub stake needs.

lock.description: Always none: unstake works at any time.

minStake.description: Minimum active stake, in whole tokens.

minimumRule.description: How a hub minimum is derived.

staking.description: How to stake this market, or null when its chain has no stake contract.

title: One market in detail
